shelters.name: Idaho Humane Society
shelters.description: Advocates for welfare and responsible care of animals, protects from neglect and cruelty. Provides animal care and control for Boise, Eagle, Kuna, Meridian, and unincorporated Ada County.

shelters.name: West Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) serving Canyon County with holistic services including temporary housing, medical care, food support, enrichment, and behavioral modification.

shelters.name: Meridian Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides community service and personalized care for canines housed at MVHS Canine Rescue.

shelters.name: Snake River Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No-kill nonprofit animal shelter and rescue. Mission to improve and save animal lives by promoting quality care and compassion through adoption and humane education.

shelters.name: Heart of Idaho Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: Rescues, rehabilitates, finds permanent homes for animals in need. Advocates for animal welfare, humane treatment, and population control. Offers permanent residence to animals.

shelters.name: Idaho Animal Rescue Network
shelters.description: Founded 2019 to address critical gap in animal rescue. 501(c)(3) nonprofit offering foster-based care, veterinary support, and outreach. Recognized with Lewiston Police Department Merit Award.

shelters.name: Bannock Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Pocatello area with companion animal adoption services.

shelters.name: A2A Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) animal rescue focused on maintaining healthy animal population in Pocatello area. All animals placed in foster homes.

shelters.name: Bonneville Humane Society
shelters.description: Rescuing and rehoming animals since 1973. Independent nonprofit funded by donations and on-site Thrift Store. Dedicated to rescue, rehabilitation, and responsible pet ownership.

shelters.name: Idaho Falls Animal Services
shelters.description: Provides top-notch services to City of Idaho Falls, assisting community with animal-related questions and solutions.

shelters.name: People for Pets - Twin Falls Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Protects and cares for community's lost, abandoned, abused, and rescued domesticated animals. Staff and volunteers provide care while animals await forever homes.

shelters.name: Companions Animal Center
shelters.description: Formerly Kootenai Humane Society, saving lives of unwanted, abused, and neglected animals since 1979.

shelters.name: Better Together Animal Alliance
shelters.description: Enriches lives of dogs, cats, and people. Serves North Idaho's Bonner, Boundary, and Kootenai Counties with support, resources, and care.

shelters.name: Lewis Clark Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Nonprofit connecting animals with loving families in Lewiston, Clarkston, and surrounding communities for decades. Provides medical care and rehabilitation.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Palouse
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter founded in 1978. Mission to ensure humane treatment, welfare and safety of companion animals in Moscow and Latah County.

shelters.name: IDAWG - Idaho Domestic Animal Welfare Group
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit since June 2000, staffed entirely by volunteers. Rescues, fosters, and rehomes animals in Treasure Valley. Offers spay/neuter financial assistance to seniors.

shelters.name: Lake Lowell Animal Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit private animal rescue specializing in abandoned cats, dogs, and small domestic animals around Treasure Valley and Lake Lowell wildlife refuge.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Idaho animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Idaho Humane Society is the largest organization serving the Boise metro. Companions Animal Center (formerly Kootenai Humane Society) has served since 1979. Coverage spans Boise, Caldwell, Meridian, Idaho Falls, Twin Falls, Pocatello, Coeur d'Alene, Lewiston, Moscow, Sandpoint, and Nampa.
